project_context.vibe: Audio hardware synthesizer, Teenage Engineering inspired, brutalist, precise, functional studio equipment.

typography.anti_pattern_avoidance: Do not use Inter. Keep headings stark, heavily weighted, and tightly tracked. Data numbers must use JetBrains Mono.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Dense and deliberate. The 'Control Room' grid. Like a physical mixing console.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Grid layout with tight spacing. Use 'grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4' with 'gap-4' or 'gap-px' to mimic hardware modules. For main layout panes, use CSS Grid to partition screen space exactly.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous internal padding (p-6, p-8) inside panels, but zero wasted space between structural bounds.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none or maximum rounded-sm (2px). No soft curves. It must feel like cut metal or plastic hardware.

surface_strategies.panels_and_cards: Flat background (bg-[#141414]), sharp 1px solid border (border-[#333333]), NO shadow. On hover, border brightens to border-[#555555].
surface_strategies.headers: Solid #0A0A0A background with a strict 1px bottom border (#333333). No glassmorphism. Structural and rigid.
surface_strategies.inputs_and_textareas: Square corners, bg-[#0A0A0A] or bg-transparent, sharp borders. Focus state must have a 1px solid ring of #FF3B30. Textareas for TTS should feel like a code editor or raw data terminal.
surface_strategies.buttons: Brutalist block elements. Primary action: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white hover:bg-[#D63026]. Secondary action: bg-transparent border border-[#333333] hover:border-white text-white. All buttons must have an active/pressed state that shrinks them slightly.

components_and_interactions.voice_explorer: A dense bento grid of voice profiles. Each item is a rigid card with a minimalist portrait, monospaced ID label, and a stark play button. Hover reveals audio waveforms or specs.
components_and_interactions.audio_player: Custom minimalist HTML5 audio player. Build the visual representation using absolute positioned divs or canvas for waveforms. Monospaced timecodes.
components_and_interactions.tts_playground: Split screen: left side is a massive, borderless textarea for script input; right side is a dense column of sliders (pitch, speed, stability) styled as hardware faders.
components_and_interactions.audiobook_studio: File upload zone that looks like a technical drop zone. Timeline visualization for dialogue parsing. Distinct, color-coded markers for different character voices.
components_and_interactions.chat_assistant: Terminal CLI vibe. Monospaced user inputs, precise AI responses.
components_and_interactions.animations: No bouncy or slow animations. Use 100ms or 150ms durations for hover states. Crisp, instant feedback.

hero_abstract.description: Minimalist headphone silhouette for the main hero or studio header visual.

equipment_texture.description: Subtle studio keyboard texture. Use as a darkened background header element if needed.

instructions_to_main_agent.framework_constraints: CRITICAL: The frontend MUST be vanilla HTML/CSS/JS. DO NOT initialize React, Next.js, or use Shadcn UI. You must construct the UI entirely with standard DOM structures and JavaScript logic.
instructions_to_main_agent.styling_approach: Use Tailwind CSS via CDN (<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>) or build step. Extend the Tailwind config in your script to include the custom colors and fonts defined above.
instructions_to_main_agent.iconography: Use Phosphor Icons via CDN (e.g., script tag for Phosphor icons) or basic inline SVGs. Do not attempt to run yarn add for React packages.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, voice cards, file inputs, textareas) MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='voice-card-1', data-testid='play-tts-button').
instructions_to_main_agent.structure: Create separate logical containers using IDs in HTML, and attach event listeners in a centralized JS file. Ensure separation of concerns even without a framework.
